snippet.title: Obey Me! Japan Release Official Music Video
snippet.description:
Information -- 
Official website: https://shallwedate.jp/obeyme/en/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/obeyme.solmare/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/Obey_me_official/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ObeyMeOfficial1

Android
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nttsolmare.game.android.obeyme
iOS
https://apps.apple.com/app/id1477167654

◆Song Info:
"Celestial Ray" is the new "Obey Me!" theme song written and performed by the voice of Asmodeus, Miura Ayme!
This fast-paced song encapsulates the world you've come to know and love in the game and is a must listen!
Find it now on all major streaming services!

Obey Me! Japan Release Official Music Video Song - Celestial Ray:
https://youtu.be/cNnNtUF_H0E
Streaming Info:
https://nex-tone.link/93224


◆Obey Me! Official Opening - Sinful Indulgence
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1k4bpAIATdw

◆Audio Dramas

Obey Me! Audio Drama #01 — Save Me, Lucifer
https://youtu.be/rZ-ZnGEiymw

Obey Me! Audio Drama #02 — Mammon and the Cat
https://youtu.be/WgEcM5ks5L0

Obey Me! Audio Drama #03 — Levi's Maid Café Rehearsal
https://youtu.be/HbVjJpHHq2c

Obey Me! Audio Drama #04 — Stop Reading Over My Shoulder! 
https://youtu.be/WQYgDSzHW6I

Download links for released Obey Me! songs -- 

Sinful Indulgence:
https://fanlink.to/SinfulIndulgence

Sinful Indulgence (EN Ver.):
https://fanlink.to/SinfulIndulgenceEN

Obey Me! Character Song Project
#01 Lucifer — "Arcadia":
https://linkco.re/vrzQfcE8

#02 Mammon — "Are You Ready?":
https://linkco.re/BM6bunUS

#03 Leviathan — "My Chance!":
https://linkco.re/c0QGTgMv

#04 Satan — "Read My Heart":
https://linkco.re/12yXnrtp
